unjust.m: Not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception.

unjustifiable.m: Incapable of being justified or explained.

unjustifiably.e: He is unjustifiably harsh on her.

unjustly.e: He was unjustly singled out for punishment.

unjustness.m: The practice of being unjust or unfair.

unjustnesses.m: The practice of being unjust or unfair.
